PaymentService/Get.sync_payment: PaymentService/Get depends on a CHARGED card payment (no3ds_auto_capture_credit_card); FIRE only supports open_banking payments and the PSU's ASPSP browser/app redirect cannot be driven by automated CI, so no completed transaction is available to sync.
PaymentService/Get.sync_upi_collect: FIRE does not support UPI payments.
PaymentService/Get.sync_upi_intent: FIRE does not support UPI payments.
PaymentService/Get.sync_upi_qr: FIRE does not support UPI payments.

PaymentService/Refund.refund_full_amount: FIRE Bank Pay refunds are only accepted against SETTLED payments; an open-banking payment reaches SETTLED only after the PSU completes the ASPSP browser/app redirect, which automated CI cannot drive. No SETTLED payment is available to refund.

RefundService/Get.refund_sync: RefundService/Get depends on a completed FIRE refund, which first requires a SETTLED open-banking payment; the PSU's ASPSP browser/app redirect cannot be driven by automated CI, so no refund is available to sync.
